rationale: A has the more distinctive art direction: a glowing moon over aurora wave lines, a staggered hero with floating phone callouts, and a sticky Listen/Adapt/Wake sequence whose sleep-stage chart changes with the time of night, ending on a warm sunrise download section. B is tasteful and editorial, with clean masked-headline entrances, a marquee, a sticky phone that changes screens, word-by-word text reveals, and teal and cream section shifts. Its near-black hero feels emptier and less memorable, though. B's hover states are clearer (animated underlines, outline brighten, CTA glow) than A's subtle pill and brighten effects. Both mobile layouts are clean.
